title: The Blonde Man, the campus, and the cult
content: I have notebook filled with dreams involving the mallworld. But when I had them and wrote them down I had never even heard of Mallworld. I've talked about some theaters I've been to elsewhere within the mall. One of those being basically hell. This is another one of those... It started out with me being in what was either a college or high school campus. I was in a classroom, alone. I then noticed a group of guys outside in the hallway yelling at me to get out of the room. I could see them through a large window. I had taken off my shoes. So I got up and walked out into the hallway. One of the guys closed the door behind me. The lights in the room went out. I recognized this place from another dream. To one side were a pair of doors that led to a parking lot. But to one side there was an elevator. This elevator would take anyone to a utility corridor that eventually leads to the mall. They started to tell me that I was luck I didn't get killed. They told me that an evil entity lived in that classroom and that it didn't like guys. It would hurt or kill them if they stepped foot in that room. I said "it didn't do a thing to me". That's when one of the guys point to the window. As I looked into the room I saw a young woman appear towards the back of the room and quickly walk towards the window. She had a white and blue hue to her. She was actually very beautiful to look at. I didn't feel any threat from her. She seemed sad and it felt like she was trapped there. She placed her hand on the window. For some reason I did the same. Right as I was about to go back into the room, this blonde man showed up. He was wearing black pants and a blue shirt. I got a shady vibe off of him. But he said "I know another place on campus that has another ghost. Who wants to come with me to see her". The guys, about 5 of them, said yes. I ended following them down hallway with blue lockers on both sides. At the end of the hallway were two doors. The blonde man then opened the door and led us into this new location. I had never seen this place before. It was a giant library. The blonde man led us directly through the place. There were a few other people here and there. Some reading, some just sitting there. I noticed these crystals set up through out the library and asked the blonde man what they were. He said that it was a secret and all he could tell us was that it was an experimental device. The crystals would emit a strong light beam that could trap souls and imprison them. they were using it to catch an entity that was in the library causing trouble. He ordered some guy to turn them on. sure enough a beam of light came out of one and would bounce from one crystal to the next. Suddenly a ghostly little girl appeared out of nowhere and was caught in the light. The man then yelled for it to be trapped. the girl vanished. He then looked at us and asked if we wanted to go and check out another place. A place that would scare us but that he hoped we would enjoy. He took us out of this building via some nearby doors and led us out into the campus. Now it really looked like a college mixed with a mall. there were cart vendors here and there selling food. I have never drank or eaten anything from any of the vendors in the mall. I've always felt there was something wrong with the food. He pointed out some motorbikes and said we could borrow them. We had to drive to the other side of the campus. As we did we passed by parking lots and smaller stores that were connected to the outside of what I believe is the mall. Then we arrived at the location. It was a strip mall. Run down. there was a liquor store and a tire shop nearby. The Blonde guy led us all to a door that was tucked away in a corner. This door had a tiny little window. The blond guy knocked on the door. The window slid open and the face of an old man peeked out. they exchanged some words I couldn't understand. The door opened and the blonde guy invited us in. As we walked in we were in a small waiting area. The carpet and walls were a dark red color. Maybe maroon? At this point we were allowed to roam around. I took my eyes off the guys for a second and when I looked back they were gone. I then noticed that there were a bunch of old men walking around the place. Some were sitting. But they were all dressed alike. They all were black tuxedos. Some wear black bow ties, others red. A lot of them were bald on the top of their heads. There were some theater seats to the left of the entrance and stairs that led up to a curtained up area. The curtains are the same color as the walls and carpet. I notice one of the old men enter a nearby room. I follow him in and find myself in a very small theater-like room. There was no stage or screen. But there was some kind table at the bottom and two men standing next to it. I apologized for interrupted them and went back out. I then noticed a group of these same men walking up the stairs towards the curtain above. The curtain opened and beyond that was another one of those small theater rooms More theater seats and down below two men stood around a table. But I noticed it was an operating table. Some men started to hand out some dark red/maroon cloaks with hoods. They kept saying that if we didn't wear them, we were not a part of them. I refused to put the cloak on and I went to sit at the very top of the theater seats. At this point they started to show us a film on a screen. It showed man being tortured by two men. Then an imp like creature came out from one side and jumped on the table and sat down on the man's legs. The imp then started to use a knife to cut open the man's stomach. he pulled out the man's guts and started to lay them on the table around the body. The men in the film were chanting something. That's when the very same type of imps started coming into the room we were in. The tuxedo'd men started to tell us to not fear them. That they were our friends as long as we gave in to them and what they wanted. Whatever that was. They were handing out sweets. Like donuts, cookies and other snacks. The guys that I was sitting next to had also refused to wear the cloaks. There were other guys sitting closer to where the table was. they were all wearing the cloaks. I refused to eat the snacks and then started to tell the other guys not to eat them. They were poison. If they ate them, they owned you. I turned around and pulled open the curtain behind us. Behind us were the other theater seats I mentioned before and I, along with the other guys, made a break for it. We ran as the tuxedo's men tried to grab us. They were trying to hold us back. I was the first one out the door and back outside. Luckily many of the other guys got out. Somehow, I don't remember how, we ended up back at the college. I remembered I needed to go back and grab my shoes from the classroom. That's when I noticed that the guys had started to eat some burritos from a nearby vendor. At that point I felt like I was alone. I even asked if anyone wanted to follow me to the room. No one answered me except for the same blonde guy. We walked all the way back to the classroom. He then said he would meet me outside in the parking lot. I was able to go into the room and grab my shoes. When I left the building I was out in the college/mall parking lot. But the guy was gone and I could not find my way around. He just left me there stranded. I was lost. it was also night time now. But I woke up at that point.
